name: Appendectomy
description: Surgical removal of the appendix.

name: Cataract Surgery
description: Removal of the cloudy lens from the eye and replacement with an artificial one.

name: Bypass Surgery
description: Procedure to restore blood flow to the heart by bypassing blocked arteries.

name: Cesarean Section
description: Surgical delivery of a baby through an incision in the mother's abdomen and uterus.

name: Endoscopy
description: Use of a flexible tube to view and treat internal parts of the digestive tract.

name: Blood Transfusion
description: Transfer of blood or blood components into a person's circulation.

name: Dialysis
description: Mechanical filtering of blood for patients with kidney failure.

name: Vaccination
description: Administration of a vaccine to stimulate immune response.

name: Biopsy
description: Surgical removal of tissue for diagnostic examination.

name: Angioplasty
description: Procedure to open narrowed or blocked blood vessels of the heart.

name: Tonsillectomy
description: Surgical removal of the tonsils.

name: Lumbar Puncture
description: Withdrawal of spinal fluid via a needle in the lower back.

name: Skin Grafting
description: Transplantation of skin to cover damaged or missing areas.

name: Hernia Repair
description: Surgical correction of a hernia by repositioning and strengthening the muscle wall.

name: Cholecystectomy
description: Removal of the gallbladder due to gallstones or inflammation.

name: Hysterectomy
description: Surgical removal of the uterus.

name: Amputation
description: Removal of a limb or part of a limb due to injury, infection, or disease.

name: Mastectomy
description: Surgical removal of one or both breasts, typically to treat or prevent cancer.

name: Circumcision
description: Removal of the foreskin from the penis.

name: Tracheostomy
description: Surgical creation of an opening in the neck to place a breathing tube into the windpipe.

name: Nasal Irrigation
description: Flushing of the nasal passages with saline to relieve congestion or mucus.

name: Steam Inhalation
description: Inhaling warm, moist air to ease nasal congestion and throat irritation.

name: Nebulization
description: Delivery of medication via a mist inhaled into the lungs, used for breathing relief.

name: Throat Swab Treatment
description: Application of antiseptic or medicated swabs to soothe sore throat and reduce infection.

name: Saline Nasal Spray
description: Non-invasive procedure to moisturize and clear nasal passages.
